data.source_credit: WDC-SILSO, Royal Observatory of Belgium, Brussels; V2.0; https://doi.org/10.24414/qnza-ac80; CC BY-NC 4.0
data.missing_policy: Per-channel forward fill; leading missing=0; exclude incomplete target rows
data.timestamp_policy: Source order; unique regular hourly/monthly grid; insert missing grid rows
data.upstream_interpolation_policy: SILSO February 1824 marked missing; forward-filled from January

selection_rule: Lowest prefix prequential FPE standardized loss; ties use grid order
heldout_policy: Freeze this file before the first full pass. No retuning after index split.
deterministic_experts: No gate initialization; repeating identical real experts for three seeds adds no variation
